channel.title: Swansea Labour news

item.title: Labour's restoration brings much-loved Helwick lightship home to Swansea
item.description:
The Helwick lightship is heading home after a £648,369 restoration paid for by Swansea's Labour council, with a winter berth on the Tawe before she returns to the marina.
#Swansea #SwanseaLabour #BuildingABetterSwansea #Waterfront #Heritage
Promoted by Rob Stewart on behalf of Swansea Labour, 9 Pontarddulais Road, Gorseinon, Swansea SA4 4FE.
